instruction:
Skylit Art Studio Issue Set

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create the Archicad model as needed and save the required outputs as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf with size at least 500 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcBuildingStorey entity and exactly 5 IfcSpace entities.
5. The IFC model contains at least 1 IfcSlab entity, and at least 3 IfcRoof entities.
6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: STUDIO, GALLERY, STORE, PANTRY, WC.
7. Every listed space is assigned to the single IfcBuildingStorey.
8. The shaped IFC product bounding box is within 0.5 m of min [0.0, 0.0, -0.3] and max [16.0, 12.0, 5.95].
9. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.pdf has exactly 2 pages and extracted text contains at least these case-insensitive tokens: A141, PLAN, SECTION, SKYLIT ART STUDIO, STUDIO, GALLERY, STORE, WC.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
